# defineScript

The one top-level function: a script's kind, what it reads, its parameters and its `run`.

Every example below is a complete script that passes the kit's checks; the kit's tests run each one.

- [`defineScript`](#definescript): A script: its kind (part, layout or route), what it reads, its typed parameters and its run.

## defineScript

A script: its kind (part, layout or route), what it reads, its typed parameters and its run. The default export of every script.

```ts
function defineScript<P extends Record<string, ParameterDecl>>(spec: { kind: "part" | "layout" | "route"; reads: ScriptReads; parameters: P; presets?: { id: string; label: string; values: Record<string, string | number | boolean> }[]; run(ctx: ScriptContext, values: ValuesOf<P>): void | Promise<void> }): ScriptDefinition
```

Topics: script, start, parameters, reads, how to write

<details><summary>Example script</summary>

```ts
import { defineScript, units, routes, parts, building, equipment, documents, checks } from "@permitzip/bim-script";
export default defineScript({
  kind: "layout",
  reads: { levels: true },
  parameters: {},
  run(ctx) {
    ctx.label("One new level");
    ctx.edit({ type: "create_level", levelId: ctx.id("level"), name: "Roof", elevationMm: 9000 });
  },
});
```

</details>
